text:
**Tree-cover loss was detected, but the evidence does not establish whether the forest was cleared.** About 0.7 hectares—1.2% of the 58.1-hectare property—lost tree cover in 2023. The entire affected area was mapped as forest in 2020.

The 2021 national forest map classified 0.4 hectares of the affected area as planted eucalyptus forest and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest. The loss could reflect plantation harvesting or another cause, and does not by itself establish deforestation or land-use change.

A further 0.4 hectares of loss was detected in smaller patches that did not meet the event-size threshold.
